source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    1. Boot to BIOS setup menu
    2. Check the value of Project Version in Main page

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Value of Project Version should be shown correctly

deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "cat /sys/class/dmi/id/bios_version 2>&1; echo ---; sudo dmidecode -t 0 2>&1 | grep -iA1 'BIOS Information' 2>&1"
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL return the bios_version from sysfs + `dmidecode -t 0` header (Project Version field). No RISK.

original_test_intent: Visually verify that the BIOS Main-page Project Version matches the approved firmware identifier for the target project and build.
original_method: Enter BIOS Setup, capture the Project Version label/value, compare it to the project release reference, optionally correlate sysfs and full SMBIOS Type 0 only through a documented mapping, then exit safely.
manual_activity: A human must observe the labeled Project Version on the pre-OS Main page; the OS BIOS version may represent a different firmware identifier.
safety_requirements: Do not infer UI Project Version from sysfs without mapping.
Preserve logs and verify normal boot.
agent_execution_scope: Collect/prepare the exact read-only sysfs and dmidecode command outputs when later approved.
Report differences without claiming UI observation or verdict.
engineer_actions: Supply the expected project identifier and approve window.
Capture the exact Main-page Project Version.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Useful as secondary inventory, but the `grep -A1` header may omit the version line and neither source proves equivalence to Project Version.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve the exact command; retain full raw Type 0 and use it only after field mapping, with UI evidence primary.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Exact sysfs/dmidecode command and 10/10-minute fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Tie the captured UI value to the approved release manifest/build and attach mapped raw inventory only as corroboration.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Specified project, board and BIOS build.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BIOS/BMC, OS and dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project release manifest or owner-approved firmware matrix.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds authoritative project provenance and guards against inventory-field conflation.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Generic library cannot supply a single permanent Project Version.

project_override_considerations: The actual expected value is intentionally project-owned. Supplying it makes the case executable and does not make the master library permanently BLOCKED or change the UI acceptance scope.
expected_evidence: Mapped sysfs/full Type 0 cross-check if used

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: All primary fields target Project Version. Its project-specific value is an expected input, not a source contradiction.

blocked_analysis.analysis: A project-supplied expected value and console make execution ready; their absence does not permanently block the library case.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes command-only YES because inventory mapping is unproven.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Agrees on manual UI core and project reference.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Explicitly applies the master-library/project-override rule and separates readiness from verdict.

review_improvement: Keeps the case reusable across projects without inventing a version and prevents a generic BIOS inventory value from replacing the UI field.
independent_technical_reasoning: Project Version is project-dependent but the source still requires a specific visual Main-page field. Missing the project value is readiness, while human UI observation makes the automation class MANUAL ONLY.
no_automatic_retry: Do not re-enter Setup automatically after a mismatch or unmapped inventory result; preserve the project/UI evidence and stop.
